params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output 'RUN npm-check'; cmd.exe /d /s /c "npm run check"; $check=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('NPM_CHECK_EXIT=' + $check); Write-Output 'RUN npm-test'; cmd.exe /d /s /c "npm test"; $test=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('NPM_TEST_EXIT=' + $test); if($check -ne 0){exit 21}; if($test -ne 0){exit 22}; exit 0
